title: Microbial community in syngas biomethanation in fed-batch mode at mesophilic and thermophilic temperature
description: Syngas fed-batch test on three different substrates, defined basal medium, digestate from thermophilic co-digestion biogas plant operated mainly on food waste, and reject water from dewatered digested sewage sludge.
samples: MIMARKS Survey related sample from wastewater metagenome
